verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships 'Pydantic Evals', a dedicated code-first framework for scoring agent quality (docs-13, docs-21), which as pure Python is naturally CI-friendly, and Logfire integration provides trace/span data for scoring runs (docs-14, docs-22). However there is no explicit documentation or example showing CI pipeline wiring (e.g. GitHub Actions, pass/fail gating) for evals. Missing for 10: documented CI integration examples/CI-specific tooling, independent evidence of teams running evals in CI, and any pass/fail threshold or gating mechanism tied to CI.
